_description: Canonical production configuration behind every result in the IJIES manuscript (Table 17). server.js implements these values; validate_flood.py reads the validation block.

grid.terrain: data/raster/dtm_bandung_wgs84.bin (DEMNAS-derived DTMUTM.tif, EPSG:32748, cell-averaged by convert_dtm.py)

hydrodynamics.river_inflow: Citarum and Cikapundung centrelines; coefficient 0.0003 + 0.0004*min(P/100,4); first 0.5 + 0.1*min(P/100,4) of the steps

routing.edge_depth: maximum simulated depth along the full edge geometry

controlled_routing_evaluation: experiments/synthetic_routing_eval.js (design fixed in its CFG block; results in experiments/results/)
